name: 利爪撕裂
description: 对1格内1名敌人造成等同攻击力的物理伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.round(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: result.success, message: caster.name + '使用利爪撕裂对' + target.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点物理伤害' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '对1格内1名敌人造成' + Math.round(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier) + '点物理伤害。', expectedValues: { damage: Math.round(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier), range: 1 } }; }
